name: SIME
recent: Sime Darby 于 2026 年 11 月 12 日召开第 20 届常年股东大会及特别股东大会，所有普通决议案均获通过，包括设立长期激励计划（含员工配股与认股权计划）及向集团首席执行官 Dato' Jeffri Salim Davidson 的分配。近期公告主要为 EPF、Amanah Saham Bumiputera 及 KWAP 等主要股东（Substantial Shareholders）的持股变动申报。新闻方面，公司就 RM150.18mil 税务评估提出上诉，另 Sime Darby Property 的 Kulai 土地交易与季度业绩亦受关注。
notable: 第 20 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 11 月 12 日举行，所有普通决议案获通过。
特别股东大会于 2026 年 11 月 12 日举行，通过设立长期激励计划及向集团首席执行官分配相关权益。
公司就 RM150.18mil 税务评估提出上诉。
risks: 公司就 RM150.18mil 税务评估提出上诉，结果待定。
主要股东 EPF、Amanah Saham Bumiputera 及 KWAP 近期多次申报持股变动。
earnings: 2026 财年（截至 6 月 30 日）营收 RM16,710mil，净利 RM322mil，净利率 1.9%；营收环比增 6.1%，净利环比降 50.8%；营收同比降 5.9%，净利同比降 57.8%，前期净利率为 4.2%。

recent_en: Sime Darby held its 20th AGM and an EGM on 12 November 2026, where all ordinary resolutions were passed, including the establishment of a long-term incentive plan (comprising an employee share grant scheme and an employee share option scheme) and the allocation to Group CEO Dato' Jeffri Salim Davidson. Recent announcements were mainly changes in substantial shareholders' interests by EPF, Amanah Saham Bumiputera and KWAP. In the news, the company is appealing RM150.18mil in tax assessments, while Sime Darby Property's Kulai land deal and quarterly results also drew attention.
notable_en: The 20th AGM was held on 12 November 2026 and all ordinary resolutions were passed.
An EGM was held on 12 November 2026, approving the establishment of a long-term incentive plan and the allocation to the Group CEO.
The company is appealing RM150.18mil in tax assessments.
risks_en: The company is appealing RM150.18mil in tax assessments, with the outcome pending.
Substantial shareholders EPF, Amanah Saham Bumiputera and KWAP have made multiple filings on changes in their shareholdings recently.
earnings_en: For FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was RM16,710mil and net income RM322mil, with a net margin of 1.9%; revenue rose 6.1% QoQ while net income fell 50.8% QoQ; revenue declined 5.9% YoY and net income fell 57.8% YoY, versus a prior net margin of 4.2%.
